hypothesis: Two llm-akg-durable agents playing 500 hands each build independent opponent models of the same match from opposite seats. This is an exploratory run testing AKG graph behavior at scale and agent adaptation against a memory-equipped opponent. Key questions: do pattern nodes emerge and get invalidated as the opponent adapts? Does the graph stay coherent at 500 hand nodes? Do the two memory files tell a consistent story of the same match from opposite perspectives?
